'''Barriss Offee''' piloted a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] used this [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|smash through]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] over [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] with the help of fellow Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], allowing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to send their [[Clone trooper/Legends|troops]] to capture the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], including the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin's]] forces.

==Behind the scenes==
Barriss Offee's Delta-7B first appeared in [[Darkness on Umbara]], an episode of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|the Clone Wars]] animated television series. As with [[Adi Gallia's Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Adi Gallia's Delta-7B]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]'' along with [[Saesee Tiin's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Saesee Tiin's Delta-7B]] and [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter|Ahsoka Tano's Delta-7B]], Offee's ship shares hull graphics identical in all but color with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B]]. This suggests a reuse of graphics by the production team.
